SIMULATED BUSINESS. This is a fictional policy for a synthetic company. It is not real.

1. Products carry a 120 day limited warranty against manufacturing defects, measured from the delivery date.
2. A defect claim must include a description and a photograph of the defect.
3. A defective product is repaired or replaced at our discretion; a refund is offered only when no replacement is available.
4. Damage that occurs in transit must be reported within 14 days of delivery and is handled as a delivery claim.
5. Normal wear, misuse and unauthorized modification are not covered by the warranty.
6. Digital add-ons are not covered by the warranty once they have been accessed.
7. Warranty claims on items flagged final_sale are limited to manufacturing defects reported within 45 days of delivery.
8. A warranty replacement carries the remaining warranty period of the original product.
9. A warranty claim does not extend or restart the refund window.
